request.style: English, children's choir, bright unison children's voices with two young soloists, piano, light strings and glockenspiel, joyful and innocent, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When I look up at the sky
The moon and stars you made
What are we that you think of us
And care for us each day

[Chorus]
Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name
In all the earth, in all the earth
From the mouths of children you made strength
Lord, our Lord

[Verse]
Every little voice can sing
And every child can pray
You set your splendor in the heavens
And hear the songs we raise

[Chorus]
Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name
In all the earth, in all the earth
From the mouths of children you made strength
Lord, our Lord
